author: ganymed_e
quote:
**** pretty much just grand theft redemption 3. the ideas are taken straight out of rdr2, like with chapters, the house building, the monotonous tasks that make you wonder if you're really playing a gta game, the honor system, collectables, explorables and even animations. how do you spend 2 billion dollars and 13 years on developing a game, only for it to be nothing like the predecessors? red dead redemption 2 is a great game, because its trying to be itself. now you have rdr3 disguised as a gta game. 

jason sounds like a celibate idiot who's mouth is stuffed the whole time, making him sound kinda like scott stapp from creed. its atrocious to listen and play as him. the first hours (not a few hours either) are spent doing chores. sure, you can commit crimes when the game allows you to (there are limitations to grand theft auto (the crime) in grand theft auto (the game)), but the main missions feel like side missions, which doesnt entice the player to play the main missions. again, in rdr2 it worked great because the game is meant to be played that way. but this simply isnt rdr2. 

also, why did they feel the need to change the controls? they were good the way they were. and *targeting* 30 fps in 2026? really? and whats up with every critic giving it a 99 or 100? some shady stuff going on from taketwo is my bet. either blacklisted bad reviews, or paid off the "acclaimed gaming reviewers"... crazily dystopian.

i have to give credit where credit's due, the lighting is amazing. the graphics have improved since the last installment, as should be expected. the map design from the pause menu map, to the map itself, are pretty sick. boats have an actual use now, which lacked in pretty much both gta iv and v.
